id: 5d2e9f1c-8b3a-4c7e-a6d8-9e1f3b5c7a64
status: experimental
description: BabaDeda's Storage Crypter stage reads its encrypted payload material from external storage-like .Control.dat files (e.g. List.Control.dat) co-located with a benign-looking signed binary, decoding only moments before execution. Hunts file accesses to *.Control.dat outside legitimate software-install paths.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/clickfix-campaigns-expand-malware.html
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1140
  - attack.t1027.009
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\List.Control.dat'
      - '.Control.dat'
  filter_legit:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
      - 'C:\Windows\'
  condition: selection_name and not filter_legit
falsepositives:

status: experimental
description: Detects HTTP requests against vLLM /v1/* endpoints where the Host header contains reserved URL characters ('/' or '?') used to bypass starlette AuthenticationMiddleware (CVE-2026-48746).

title: Langflow Python Runtime Spawning Shell or Network LOLBin (CVE-2026-48519 RCE Outcome)
id: 3c91d4a7-5e8b-4f12-b9a3-2d6c8e1f7042
status: experimental
description: Detects the Langflow python/uvicorn process spawning a shell, curl, wget, nc, or other network-capable utility — the direct execution outcome of exploiting the Shareable Playground RCE.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v5ff-9q35-q26f
  - https://research.jfrog.com/post/langflow-latest-version-was-not-fixed/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1203
  - cve.2026-48519
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/python3.10'
      - '/python3.11'
      - '/python3.12'
      - '/uvicorn'
      - '/gunicorn'
  selection_parent_cmd:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'langflow'
      - 'uvicorn langflow'
      - 'langflow.main'
      - 'langflow run'
  selection_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/socat'
      - '/busybox'
  selection_child_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/dev/tcp/'
      - 'bash -i'
      - 'sh -c '
      - 'touch /tmp/pwned'
      - 'chmod +x /tmp'
  condition: (selection_parent or selection_parent_cmd) and (selection_child_image or selection_child_cmd)
falsepositives:

  - Container init scripts launching langflow alongside other utilities under a shared shell wrapper

2509.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — GhostTree Attack Abused Recursive Windows Junctions to Hide Malware
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("program.exe") or FolderPath has_any ("C:\Parent\program.exe", "C:\Parent\Child", "C:\Parent\Child\Program.exe", "C:\Parent\Child\Child\Program.exe", "C:\Parent\Child\Child\Child\Child\Program.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\Parent\program.exe", "C:\Parent\Child", "C:\Parent\Child\Program.exe", "C:\Parent\Child\Child\Program.exe", "C:\Parent\Child\Child\Child\Child\Program.exe", "C:\Parent\Child1", "C:\Parent\Child2", "C:\Parent\Child1\Program.exe") or FileName in~ ("program.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

2568.sigma:
title: Vitest Browser Mode Started With Misleading allowWrite/allowExec False (CVE-2026-53633)
id: 5e8d2c9a-1f4b-4c6e-9a3d-7b2e1c8f4a06
description: Detects Vitest Browser Mode launched with allowWrite=false AND allowExec=false AND a network-bound host. The advisory states these flags do NOT gate CDP, so the configuration is a deceptive 'safe-looking' exposure.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g8mr-85jm-7xhm
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\node.exe'
  selection_pkg:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'vitest'
      - '@vitest/browser'
      - 'vite-plus'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|re|i:
      - 'allowWrite\s*[:=]\s*false'
      - 'allowExec\s*[:=]\s*false'
  selection_host:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'browser.api.host'
      - '0.0.0.0'
  condition: selection_img and selection_pkg and selection_flags and selection_host
level: high
2568.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="node.exe" Processes.process="*vitest*" Processes.process="*allowWrite*" Processes.process="*allowExec*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | regex process="(?i)allowWrite\s*[:=]\s*false" | regex process="(?i)allowExec\s*[:=]\s*false" | regex process="(?i)(browser\.api\.host|--host)[\s=]+(0\.0\.0\.0|::|[^\s]+)"
2568.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\node\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(vitest|@vitest\/browser|vite-plus)/i
| CommandLine=/allowWrite\s*[:=]\s*false/i
| CommandLine=/allowExec\s*[:=]\s*false/i
| CommandLine=/browser\.api\.host/i
| CommandLine=/0\.0\.0\.0/
| NOT (CommandLine=/allowCDP\s*[:=]\s*false/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2571.def:
let WindowSeconds = 30;
let ConfigWrites = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)^(vite|vitest)\.config\.(ts|js|mjs|cjs)$"
    | project ConfigWriteTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ConfigPath = FolderPath, ConfigFile = FileName, ConfigWriter = InitiatingProcessFileName, WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
ConfigWrites
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("vitest","@vitest/browser","vite")
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","wmic.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","net.exe","netsh.exe")
    | project ChildSpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ChildProcess = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, NodeCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, NodeFolderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, AccountName
) on DeviceId
| where ChildSpawnTime between (ConfigWriteTime .. ConfigWriteTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildSpawnTime, ConfigWriteTime)
| project ConfigWriteTime, ChildSpawnTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName, ConfigPath, ConfigFile, ConfigWriter, WriterCmd, ChildProcess, ChildCmd, NodeCmd
| order by ConfigWriteTime desc

    | project ConfigWriteTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ConfigPath = TargetFilePath, ConfigFile = TargetFileName, ConfigWriter = ActingProcessName;
ConfigWrites
| join kind=inner (
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ParentProcessName has "node.exe"
    | where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("vitest","@vitest/browser","vite")

    | project ChildSpawnTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ChildProcess = ActingProcessName, ChildCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine, NodeCmd = ParentProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername
) on DvcHostname
| where ChildSpawnTime between (ConfigWriteTime .. ConfigWriteTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildSpawnTime, ConfigWriteTime)
| project ConfigWriteTime, ChildSpawnTime, DelaySec, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ConfigPath, ConfigFile, ConfigWriter, ChildProcess, ChildCmd, NodeCmd
| order by ConfigWriteTime desc

id: 8f3a2d5e-7b9c-4d12-a6e8-1f2b3c4d5e6f
description: Detects makepkg or shell parent spawning npm/bun to install atomic-lockfile or js-digest, the Atomic Arch supply-chain pivot packages.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/over-400-arch-linux-aur-packages.html
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/makepkg'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/zsh'
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/npm'
      - '/bun'
      - '/node'
      - '/yarn'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'install atomic-lockfile'
      - 'install js-digest'
      - 'atomic-lockfile@1.4.2'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_image and selection_cmd
level: high
2631.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("makepkg","bash","sh","zsh") AND Processes.process_name IN ("npm","bun","node","yarn") AND (Processes.process="*install atomic-lockfile*" OR Processes.process="*install js-digest*") by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - lastTime
2631.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE (@process.command_line:(*"install atomic-lockfile"* OR *"install js-digest"* OR *"atomic-lockfile@1.4.2"*)) (@process.name:(npm OR bun OR node OR yarn))
2631.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(makepkg|bash|sh|zsh|fish)$/i
| ImageFileName=/(npm|bun|node|yarn)$/i
| regex("install\\s+(atomic-lockfile|js-digest)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2633.sigma:
title: Suspicious systemd .service Drop Outside Package Managers
id: 2b9d4c1e-5a8f-4321-9c7b-3e1d5f6a7b8c
description: Detects creation of systemd .service units by processes other than legitimate Linux package managers, matching Atomic Arch persistence pattern.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/over-400-arch-linux-aur-packages.html
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1543.002
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.service'
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/etc/systemd/system/'
      - '/.config/systemd/user/'
  filter_pkgmgr:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/pacman'
      - '/makepkg'
      - '/systemctl'
      - '/dpkg'
      - '/apt'
      - '/apt-get'
      - '/rpm'
      - '/dnf'
      - '/yum'
      - '/snapd'
      - '/flatpak'
  condition: selection and not filter_pkgmgr
level: medium
2633.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.process_name) as process_name values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="/etc/systemd/system/*.service" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.config/systemd/user/*.service") AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("pacman","makepkg","systemctl","systemd-sysv-install","dpkg","apt","rpm","dnf") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | sort - lastTime
2633.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:PATH (@file.path:("/etc/systemd/system/*\.service" OR "*/.config/systemd/user/*\.service")) -@process.name:(pacman OR makepkg OR systemctl OR dpkg OR apt OR apt-get OR rpm OR dnf OR yum OR snapd OR flatpak)
2633.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| regex("\\.service$", field=TargetFileName)
| regex("(/etc/systemd/system/|/\\.config/systemd/user/)", field=TargetFileName)
| NOT regex("(pacman|makepkg|systemctl|dpkg|apt|apt-get|rpm|dnf|yum|snapd|flatpak)$", field=ContextImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

2637.datadog: @http.url_details.path:"/api/public/v1/roles/assign" @http.method:POST @http.status_code:[200 TO 299] ("builder\":true" OR "admin\":true" OR builder%22%3Atrue OR admin%22%3Atrue)

2638.sent:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ProcessName has_any ("budibase", "node", "budibase-worker", "budibase-apps")
| where SyslogMessage has "/api/public/v1/roles/assign"
| where SyslogMessage has_any ("\"builder\":true", "\"admin\":true", "builder.global", "admin.global")

| extend AppIdHeader = extract(@"app_[a-z0-9]+", 0, SyslogMessage)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, HostName, ProcessName, GrantedScope, TargetUserId, CallerApiKey, AppIdHeader, SyslogMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc

2640.sent:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 5;
let KeyMints = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RequestURL has "/api/global/self/api_key"
    | where RequestMethod =~ "GET"
    | project KeyMintTime = TimeGenerated, MintSourceIP = SourceIP, MintSourceUser = SourceUserName, MintUA = RequestClientApplication;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RequestURL has "/api/public/v1/roles/assign"
| where RequestMethod =~ "POST"
| join kind=inner KeyMints on $left.SourceIP == $right.MintSourceIP
| where TimeGenerated between (KeyMintTime .. KeyMintTime + WindowMinutes * 1m)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, KeyMintTime)
| project KeyMintTime, AssignTime = TimeGenerated, DelaySec, SourceIP, SourceUserName, MintSourceUser, MintUA, AssignUA = RequestClientApplication, RequestURL, RequestMethod, Message
| order by AssignTime desc
2640.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as keyMintTime from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/api/global/self/api_key*" AND Web.http_method="GET" by Web.src, Web.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | join type=inner src, user [| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as assignTime values(Web.url) as urls values(Web.status) as status from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/api/public/v1/roles/assign*" AND Web.http_method="POST" by Web.src, Web.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | rename count as assignCount] | eval delaySec = assignTime - keyMintTime | where delaySec >= 0 AND delaySec <= 300 | table keyMintTime, assignTime, delaySec, src, user, assignCount, urls, status

title: AI Agent Runtime Spawns Downloader-to-Interpreter Chain
id: 9b3c7a4e-1f2e-4b1f-8a55-9c8e0c2dca77
description: Detects an AI agent runtime (OpenClaw/LangChain/AutoGPT-style) spawning curl/wget/PowerShell/bash with a URL argument or pipe-to-shell pattern, matching the Imperva OpenClaw PoC (TheHackerNews 2026-06-11) where a hidden contact-name prompt injection drove the agent to download and execute an attacker-hosted script.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/new-attacks-trick-openclaw-ai-agent.html
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_selection:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\openclaw'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3'
      - '\node.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'openclaw'
      - 'langchain'
      - 'autogpt'
      - 'agent.py'
      - 'agent.js'
  child_selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  url_selection:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - 'ftp://'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'DownloadString'
  condition: (parent_selection or 1 of parent_selection.*) and child_selection and url_selection
level: high

2676.def:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let BaselineDays = 60d;
let AgentMailboxes = dynamic([]);
let KnownRecipients = EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(LookbackDays))
    | where EmailDirection == "Outbound"
    | summarize by SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress;
let RecentOutbound = EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EmailDirection == "Outbound"
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
    | extend RecipientDomain = tolower(tostring(split(RecipientEmailAddress, "@")[1]))
    | where RecipientDomain !in~ ("gmail.com","outlook.com","hotmail.com")
    | project OutTime = Timestamp, NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, RecipientDomain, Subject, AttachmentCount;
let FirstTimeOutbound = RecentOutbound
    | join kind=leftanti KnownRecipients on SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress;
FirstTimeOutbound
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
    | project InboundTime = Timestamp, RecipientEmailAddress, InboundSubject = Subject, InboundSender = SenderFromAddress
  ) on $left.SenderFromAddress == $right.RecipientEmailAddress
| where OutTime between (InboundTime .. InboundTime + 30m)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', OutTime, InboundTime)
| project InboundTime, OutTime, DelayMin, MailboxOwner = SenderFromAddress, ExternalRecipient = RecipientEmailAddress, RecipientDomain, InboundSender, InboundSubject, OutboundSubject = Subject, AttachmentCount
| order by OutTime desc

id: 4b2a8d1f-6c9e-4d7a-91b3-2f5e8c1d4a44
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of editor/AI tool config files that auto-execute on folder open or session start, written by git/npm/pip/yarn/pnpm/tar (not by the IDE itself), matching the Miasma/Hades supply-chain delivery surface.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/miasma-and-hades-are-spreading-now-detect-them-on-developer-machines-with-suspicious-files
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1546
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  config_files:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\.vscode\tasks.json'
      - '\.vscode\setup.mjs'
      - '\.claude\setup.mjs'
      - '\.claude\settings.json'
      - '\.cursor\rules\setup.mdc'
      - '\.gemini\settings.json'
      - '\.github\setup.js'
  writer:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\git.exe'
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\pip.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\yarn.exe'
      - '\pnpm.exe'
      - '\tar.exe'
      - '\bun.exe'
  condition: config_files and writer
level: medium
2690.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\.vscode\\tasks.json" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.vscode\\setup.mjs" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.claude\\setup.mjs" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.claude\\settings.json" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.cursor\\rules\\setup.mdc" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.gemini\\settings.json" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.github\\setup.js") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.action | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where match(process_name, "(?i)^(git|npm|node|pip|python|yarn|pnpm|tar|7z|curl|wget)\.exe$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2690.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\.vscode\\tasks.json OR *\\.vscode\\setup.mjs OR *\\.claude\\setup.mjs OR *\\.claude\\settings.json OR *\\.cursor\\rules\\setup.mdc OR *\\.gemini\\settings.json OR *\\.github\\setup.js)) @Image:(*\\git.exe OR *\\npm.exe OR *\\node.exe OR *\\pip.exe OR *\\python.exe OR *\\yarn.exe OR *\\pnpm.exe OR *\\tar.exe OR *\\bun.exe OR *\\Git.exe OR *\\NPM.EXE OR *\\NODE.EXE OR *\\Python.exe)
2690.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| regex("\\\\(\\.vscode\\\\(tasks\\.json|setup\\.mjs)|\\.claude\\\\(setup\\.mjs|settings\\.json)|\\.cursor\\\\rules\\\\setup\\.mdc|\\.gemini\\\\settings\\.json|\\.github\\\\setup\\.js)$", field=TargetFileName)
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(git|npm|node|pip|python(3)?|yarn|pnpm|tar|7z|curl|wget|bun)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId], function=count())

2691.def:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("code.exe","cursor.exe","claude.exe","gemini.exe","devenv.exe")
    or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("code.exe","cursor.exe","claude.exe","gemini.exe","devenv.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("node.exe","bun.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","setup.mdc",".github\\setup.js",@"\.vscode\tasks.json",@"\.claude\settings.json",@"\.gemini\settings.json","folderOpen","SessionStart")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
2691.sent:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(code|cursor|claude|gemini|devenv)\.exe$"
| where ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(node|bun|python(3|w)?|powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|curl|wget)\.exe$"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","setup.mdc",@"\.github\setup.js",@"\.vscode\tasks.json",@"\.claude\settings.json",@"\.gemini\settings.json","folderOpen","SessionStart")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2691.sigma:
title: IDE Auto-Exec Hook Triggered - Editor Spawns Interpreter via Setup Script
id: 8d3f2c7a-5e1b-4a9c-b6d4-1f7e9c2d5b55
status: experimental
description: Detects Code/Cursor/Claude/Gemini/devenv spawning an interpreter whose command line references a setup.mjs/setup.mdc/setup.js auto-execute hook (Miasma/Hades AI/editor delivery surface).
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/miasma-and-hades-are-spreading-now-detect-them-on-developer-machines-with-suspicious-files
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.t1546
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\Code.exe'
      - '\Cursor.exe'
      - '\Claude.exe'
      - '\Gemini.exe'
      - '\devenv.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\bun.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
  cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'setup.mjs'
      - 'setup.mdc'
      - '.github\setup.js'
      - '.vscode\tasks.json'
      - '.claude\settings.json'
      - '.gemini\settings.json'
      - 'folderOpen'
      - 'SessionStart'
  condition: parent and child and cmd
level: high
2691.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Code.exe","code.exe","Cursor.exe","cursor.exe","Claude.exe","claude.exe","Gemini.exe","gemini.exe","devenv.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("node.exe","bun.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*setup.mjs*" OR Processes.process="*setup.mdc*" OR Processes.process="*setup.js*" OR Processes.process="*.vscode\\tasks.json*" OR Processes.process="*.claude\\settings.json*" OR Processes.process="*.gemini\\settings.json*" OR Processes.process="*folderOpen*" OR Processes.process="*SessionStart*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2691.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\Code.exe OR *\\code.exe OR *\\Cursor.exe OR *\\cursor.exe OR *\\Claude.exe OR *\\claude.exe OR *\\Gemini.exe OR *\\gemini.exe OR *\\devenv.exe) @Image:(*\\node.exe OR *\\bun.exe OR *\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\wget.exe) @CommandLine:(*setup.mjs* OR *setup.mdc* OR *.github\\setup.js* OR *.vscode\\tasks.json* OR *.claude\\settings.json* OR *.gemini\\settings.json* OR *folderOpen* OR *SessionStart*)
2691.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(code|cursor|claude|gemini|devenv)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(node|bun|python(3|w)?|powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|curl|wget)\.exe$/i
| regex("(setup\\.mjs|setup\\.mdc|\\.github\\\\setup\\.js|\\.vscode\\\\tasks\\.json|\\.claude\\\\settings\\.json|\\.gemini\\\\settings\\.json|folderOpen|SessionStart)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2692.def:

   or (RemoteUrl has "api.github.com" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("_index.js","bun-","setup.mjs"))

2692.sent:
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where Url has_any ("registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/publish","registry.npmjs.org/-/user","upload.pypi.org/legacy","api.github.com/user/repos","api.github.com/repos","api.github.com/gists")

2692.sigma:
title: Bun Runtime Egress to npm/PyPI Publish or GitHub Repo Endpoints
id: 2f8c5a7d-9b3e-4c1f-a5d8-7e4f9b2c3d66
status: experimental
description: Detects bun.exe (or node.exe carrying the Bun payload) making outbound HTTPS to npm publish, PyPI upload, or GitHub repo/gist creation endpoints — the Miasma/Hades worm spreading and exfiltration channels.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/miasma-and-hades-are-spreading-now-detect-them-on-developer-machines-with-suspicious-files
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/binding-gyp-npm-supply-chain-attack-spreads-like-worm
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.t1552.001
  - attack.command_and_control
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\bun.exe'
      - '\node.exe'
  dest:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - 'registry.npmjs.org'
      - 'upload.pypi.org'
      - 'api.github.com'
  condition: proc and dest
level: medium
2692.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(All_Traffic.url) as urls min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.process_name="bun.exe" AND (All_Traffic.url="*registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/publish*" OR All_Traffic.url="*registry.npmjs.org/-/user*" OR All_Traffic.url="*upload.pypi.org/legacy/*" OR All_Traffic.url="*api.github.com/user/repos*" OR All_Traffic.url="*api.github.com/repos/*/contents/*" OR All_Traffic.url="*api.github.com/repos/*/git/refs*") by All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.dest_port | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2692.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @Image:(*\\bun.exe OR *\\Bun.exe OR *\\BUN.EXE OR *\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe) @DestinationHostname:(registry.npmjs.org OR upload.pypi.org OR api.github.com)
2692.falcon:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(bun|node)\.exe$/i
| DomainName=/^(registry\.npmjs\.org|upload\.pypi\.org|api\.github\.com)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| count>0

2693.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — npm v12 delivers one of the biggest security improvements in years
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("telemetry.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("telemetry.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2693.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — npm v12 delivers one of the biggest security improvements in years ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("telemetry.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("telemetry.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2694.sigma:
title: npm/node lifecycle script downloads Bun runtime (Shai-Hulud)
id: 4b8f1c2a-7d3e-4d6a-9a1f-1e2c5b9a0d11
description: A package-manager install (npm/yarn/pnpm) or node-driven lifecycle script pulls the Bun runtime mid-install, the signature step of the Shai-Hulud / Mini Shai-Hulud worms.
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/npm-v12-block-postinstall
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npx.exe'
      - '\yarn.exe'
      - '\pnpm.exe'
  child_selection:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bun.sh/install'
      - 'github.com/oven-sh/bun'
      - 'bun install'
      - 'bun run'
      - '\bun.exe'
  condition: parent_selection and child_selection
level: high
2694.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe") OR Processes.parent_process IN ("*\\npm install*","*npm ci*","* preinstall *","* postinstall *")) (Processes.process IN ("*bun.exe*","*/bun*","*bun install*","*bun run*","*curl*bun.sh/install*","*iwr*bun.sh*","*Invoke-WebRequest*bun.sh*","*github.com/oven-sh/bun*")) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
2694.datadog: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) @ParentImage:(*\\npm.exe OR *\\NPM.EXE OR *\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\npx.exe OR *\\yarn.exe OR *\\pnpm.exe) @CommandLine:(*bun.sh/install* OR *github.com/oven-sh/bun* OR *"bun install"* OR *"bun run"* OR *\\bun.exe*)
2694.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(npm|node|npx|yarn|pnpm|corepack)\.exe$/i
| (CommandLine=/bun\.sh\/install/i OR CommandLine=/github\.com\/oven-sh\/bun/i OR CommandLine=/bun\s+install/i OR CommandLine=/bun\s+run/i OR ImageFileName=/\\bun\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=count())
